text:
jamie: Heads-up — scheduling a planned maintenance for netlink/kernel livepatch across eu-west pools on Tue 2024-09-10 02:00-04:00 UTC. Rolling reboots of affected racks (az3/az4). Draining non-dedicated GPU pools first, then hit reserved pools only if we need headroom. Expect short p95 latency spikes during node reconnects.
praveen: +1. What's our backfill plan? last time we saw 12% capacity shortfall during a storm.
sophia: Plan is to pre-warm capacity in us/eu shadow pools and enable preemptible burst for 30m. We'll seed KV cache after each rack comes back to avoid cold-cache penalties.
jamie: Exact sequence below — we'll do cohorts of 6 nodes/rack, sequentially. If any cohort fails >2 nodes, abort.
```
# high level
for rack in az3 az4:
  cordon rack-nodes --grace 300
  drain rack-nodes --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data
  reboot rack-nodes
  postcheck kvseed --pool eu-shadow
```

lee: Can we pin Dedicated customers (legacy-dedicated-eu) off those racks for the window? They can't tolerate even short degradations.
sophia: Yes — we'll emergency-route dedicated customers to pinned hosts in eu-west1-dedicated (no queueing). That reduces spare capacity; hence the pre-warm.
praveen: CPU/GPU utilisation forecast with pre-warm: we still might hit ~90% on burst. Cost impact estimate for 2h pre-warm + 1h burst: ~0.9k USD. Accounting ok with that?
jamie: @opsbot create ticket and tag finance for cost approval. Also posting to #customer-comm tomorrow.
opsbot: Created INC-4321 and cost-approval task FIN-1123. Notified finance@redwood.
lee: One more ask — add a temporary route fallback to the us region in smart-routing so if queue latency exceeds 150ms fallback kicks in.
sophia: We can enable routing fallback for requests originating outside EU for the window. Will add policy delta and a quick test at T-30m.
praveen: SRE oncall (me) will run smoke after each cohort and verify p50/p95 tail. If p95 >200ms for 2 successive cohorts we abort and rollback kernel patch.
jamie: Communications: will send a short blurb to customers with dedicated note for legacy-dedicated-eu. Template: "Planned maintenance Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC, short transient latency or capacity changes. No data impact."
lee: LGTM. I'll handle the canary tenant list and watch the first cohort.
sophia: Adding KV seed jobs and bumping cache TTLs pre-window. I'll post the exact runbook in the incident doc.
jamie: Thanks team — final call at T-60. If no blockers, start at 02:00 UTC. :spiral_calendar:
